install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-26f1e0a33d2c3e1b5bfd，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-modal-enhancer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为所有 Web UI 弹窗添加窗口化操作：标题栏拖动、八向缩放、钉住防误触关闭、全屏最大化、移除背景模糊，以及按弹窗持久化的状态。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26f1e0a33d2c3e1b5bfd.html
posts.en:
dsh-modal-enhancer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26f1e0a33d2c3e1b5bfd.html
